info.title: CC Guild API
info.description: One route tree serving two principal kinds. Every request presents a service key and a bearer token; what a request may reach is decided by the access policy, never by which credential arrived.

serviceKey.name: x-api-key
serviceKey.description: Identifies the calling app. It confers no authority on its own.

principalToken.description: An admin token from POST /v1/auth/login, or a share-link token.

AdminSession.description: A short-lived admin bearer token and its expiry

LoginPayload.description: The admin password, and nothing else

ProjectListItem.description: A project as a list row describes it: a count, no links

EntityName.description: A display name, at most 80 characters

Folder.description: A one-level grouping of tasks; folders never nest

TaskEntry.description: A task as its project manifest records it

Progress.description: Counted checklist state, derived from a document

ProjectView.description: A project, shaped for whoever asked about it

ShareLink.description: One person’s access, and who granted it

Role.description: The authority a share link carries

ProjectScope.description: What a Microtask share link may reach

NamePayload.description: A display name, and nothing else

ShareView.description: What the credential that asked can reach

SearchResults.description: What a search matched, shaped for whoever asked

SearchResult.description: One matched name, and where to find it

ExportBundle.description: An export: every project in it, with every task document

ExportedProject.description: One project and the full document of every task it names

TaskDocument.description: One task file: its tabs and nothing else

Tab.description: One tab inside a task, owning its own document

DocumentJson.description: A Tiptap document, stored as JSON and never as HTML

ImportSession.description: An open import session and the bounds on uploading to it

ImportStagedChunk.description: The path a chunk was staged at, and the bytes it added

ImportExpansion.description: What expanding one staged archive put into a session

ImportPreview.description: What one staged import session holds, before anything is written

ImportPreviewGroup.description: One dropped group, what it is, and what will happen to it

ImportShape.description: What a dropped directory group was detected as

ImportPreviewShareLink.description: A share link a bundle asserts, named by index, never by token

ImportOutcome.description: Whether a group will import, and whether it was even read

ImportConfirmResult.description: What one confirm did, project by project

ImportProjectResult.description: One project a confirm handled, and what became of it

ConflictChoice.description: Skip a project, import it as new, or replace it

ImportWriteOutcome.description: What a confirm did with one project

ImportConfirmRequest.description: Apply one staged session, one choice per project

ImportProjectChoice.description: One project and what was chosen for it

ReorderFoldersPayload.description: Every one of a project's folders, in the order wanted

CreateTaskPayload.description: A task name, and optionally the folder to file it in

ReorderTasksPayload.description: One folder group, and every task in it in the order wanted

TaskView.description: One task and its tabs, shaped for whoever asked

MoveTaskPayload.description: Where a task is being moved to; null is the project root

ReorderTabsPayload.description: Every one of a task's tabs, in the order wanted

TabDocumentSaved.description: The stamp the next conditional write must match

ShareLinkList.description: One project's share links, in minting order

CreateShareLinkPayload.description: A seat to mint: who for, what authority, and over what

UpdateShareLinkPayload.description: A new name, a new role, or both

RevokedShareLinks.description: Every share link one revocation removed

PlanListItem.description: A plan as a list row describes it: settings and counts, no contents

IsoDate.description: A YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, with no time and no zone

Timezone.description: An IANA time-zone name this runtime can resolve

PlanView.description: A plan, and the schedule computed from it

PlanEpic.description: A rail on the timeline, and what it is bound to, if anything

Position.description: A dense 0-based order within one parent

EpicBinding.description: A live link from one epic to one Microtask project

PlanFeature.description: A feature on one rail, its estimate, its pin, and its dependencies

EstimateDays.description: A non-negative whole number of working days

SprintIndex.description: A 0-based sprint number, with no upper bound

PlanItem.description: One unit of work under a feature

PlanShareLink.description: One person’s access to a plan, and who granted it

ScheduleView.description: A plan's schedule: spans, cycles, unscheduled entries, ignored edges

ScheduleSpan.description: One feature or item, placed at a working-day offset

ScheduleCycle.description: Feature ids caught in a dependency cycle

UnscheduledEntry.description: A feature or item left off the axis, and why

IgnoredEdge.description: A dependency dropped to keep rail order, and who declared it

CreatePlanPayload.description: A plan to create: its name, its start date, its calendar

PlanShareView.description: What the plan seat that asked holds

UpdatePlanPayload.description: A plan's settings, at least one of them

CreateEpicPayload.description: A rail to create: its name, and optionally its colour

EpicPlacementPayload.description: Where a rail sits among its siblings

UpdateEpicPayload.description: A new name, a new colour, or both

CreateFeaturePayload.description: A feature to create: its rail, its name, its estimate, its pin

FeaturePlacementPayload.description: Which rail a feature sits on, and where on it

DependenciesPayload.description: Every feature this one depends on

UpdateFeaturePayload.description: A new name, a new estimate, a new pin, or a clear of either

CreateItemPayload.description: An item to create: its feature, its name, its estimate

ItemPlacementPayload.description: Which feature an item sits under, and where

UpdateItemPayload.description: A new name, a new estimate, or a clear of it

CreatePlanShareLinkPayload.description: A seat to mint on a plan: who for, what authority

get.summary: Report that the process is serving
get.description: Carries no credential and reads no storage, so it answers while the disk is busy.

200.description: The process is serving

post.summary: Exchange the admin password for a token
post.description: Answers 401 for a wrong password and for an unrecognised service key, with the same document for both.

200.description: A short-lived admin token and when it expires

get.summary: List every project in this product

200.description: Every project, most recently updated first

get.summary: Describe the share link the caller presented

200.description: The role, scope and reachable tree of the credential that asked

get.description: Matches project, folder and task names. Tab names and document text are not searched (ADR 0021).

schema.description: The term to match names against, case-insensitively

parameters.description: The term to match names against, case-insensitively
parameters.name: q

200.description: Every matching name the caller may be told, in project order

get.summary: Export every project in this product
get.description: Every project, each with a document for every task it names. A task file that will not read is a 409 naming the project and the task, rather than a bundle that has quietly lost it.

schema.description: Omit every share link, or carry the links with their live tokens

parameters.description: Omit every share link, or carry the links with their live tokens
parameters.name: tokens

200.description: The bundle, with a document for every task each project names

post.description: Stages nothing yet. Every upload into this session is chunked, and opening one sweeps any session older than the staging TTL.

201.description: The session, with the chunk and session byte caps to upload within

post.summary: Upload one chunk of one file into an import session
post.description: The body is the raw bytes of one chunk, appended to this session in the order the chunks arrive. Nothing outside the session is touched.

schema.description: The normalised relative path this file was harvested at

parameters.description: The normalised relative path this file was harvested at
parameters.name: path

schema.description: How many bytes of this file the client believes are already staged

parameters.description: How many bytes of this file the client believes are already staged
parameters.name: offset

200.description: The chunk was appended, and the session now holds this many bytes

post.summary: Expand a staged zip archive into an import session
post.description: Stages every entry at the path it names, under the caps ADR 0020 sets, and removes the archive. Nothing outside the session is touched.

schema.description: The staged path of the .zip to expand, as it was uploaded

parameters.description: The staged path of the .zip to expand, as it was uploaded
parameters.name: path

200.description: The archive was expanded, and the session now holds this many bytes

get.summary: Preview what one staged import session would do
get.description: Reads the staged session and describes every group in it. Nothing is written, and no project is touched.

200.description: The plan: one row per dropped group, with every reason a group is refused

post.description: Writes every importable project under the choices given, reports what became of each, and sweeps the session either way.

requestBody.description: The session to apply and the conflict choice for each colliding project

200.description: What the confirm did, project by project

get.description: Folders, task entries, and — for a caller the policy clears — its share links.

200.description: The project, shaped for whoever asked
The project as renamed

delete.summary: Remove one project and everything under it

204.description: The project is gone, along with its tasks and its share links

get.description: This project, with a document for every task it names. A task file that will not read is a 409 naming the project and the task, rather than a bundle that has quietly lost it.

schema.description: Omit every share link, or carry the links with their live tokens

parameters.description: Omit every share link, or carry the links with their live tokens
parameters.name: tokens

200.description: The bundle, with a document for every task each project names
The folders, in the order they are shown

post.summary: Create a folder at the end of the order

200.description: The folders in their new order
The folder as renamed

delete.summary: Remove one folder, keeping the tasks it held

204.description: The folder is gone and its tasks sit at the project root

201.description: The manifest entry for the task as created

200.description: The group in its new order

get.summary: Read one task and its tabs

200.description: The task, shaped for whoever asked
The manifest entry as renamed

204.description: The task and its tabs are gone

200.description: The manifest entry where it now sits

post.summary: Create a tab at the end of the task

201.description: The tab as created, holding an empty document

200.description: The tabs in their new order
The tab as renamed

delete.summary: Remove one tab, unless it is the last

204.description: The tab and its document are gone

put.description: Requires If-Match carrying the updatedAt the client last received. A mismatch is 409 and the client reloads rather than overwriting.

schema.description: The updatedAt this write is based on

parameters.description: The updatedAt this write is based on
parameters.name: If-Match

200.description: The document was replaced
